# Download Standalone Colab Notebooks

Learners download a single prepared `.ipynb` file and upload it to Colab. No GitHub URL, authentication, or repository cloning is required during execution. Package installation requires access to public PyPI, and hands-on exercises using the actual Agents API require an API key, a model, and access permissions.

## Learners: Download and Run Notebooks

[Download ZIP of 17 standalone notebooks](https://agents-api-by-example.openai.chatgpt.site/downloads/colab-notebooks.zip) · [Download the quick-start notebook](https://agents-api-by-example.openai.chatgpt.site/downloads/colab/quickstart.ipynb)

The ZIP contains only notebooks and a README for distribution. Downloads use the access permissions of the current course materials on Sites.

1. Download the notebook or `colab-notebooks` ZIP supplied by the course materials provider. If it is a ZIP, extract it first.
2. In Colab, select **File → Upload notebook** and open the `.ipynb` file you need.
3. Run the setup cell. It installs the required packages directly into the current Python environment and creates the bundled helper, data, and example files in a temporary exercise folder.
4. For actual API exercises, set `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL` in Colab Secrets and select `RUN_LIVE=True`. The default is False; follow the setup cell's instructions to opt in to execution.

Environment setup, the quick start, Chapters 1–11, and Chapter 15 are for Python exercises. The deployment files for Chapters 12–14 are for reading only; perform Docker and internal network exercises in local Jupyter. Do not record API keys in `.ipynb`.

## Complete Exercise Files: Run Locally with Sources

[Download the complete exercise ZIP](https://agents-api-by-example.openai.chatgpt.site/downloads/exercise-files.zip)

The Colab ZIP embeds helpers in notebooks. Python source files appear in a temporary folder after running preparation cells in order from the beginning. The final preparation cell confirms the helper import and file location.

The complete ZIP includes original local notebooks, `src/tutorial_helpers/`, data, examples, skills, plugins, deployment files and dependency settings. Choose it to read or edit helpers while running locally. Extract it and run these commands inside `agents-api-examples/`.

```bash
uv sync --locked
uv run jupyter lab
```

Select the project .venv kernel and open `notebooks/setup.ipynb`. These notebooks use the local project helpers. Package installation requires internet; live API exercises require a key, model and access. See the bundled README for optional dependencies.

Providers can generate and check Korean and English exercise archives without building the Book. The integrated Book build includes both downloads. CI also provides an `exercise-files` artifact.

```bash
uv run python scripts/build_exercise_zip.py
uv run python scripts/build_exercise_zip.py --check
```

## Providers: Generate and Distribute Locally

```bash
uv sync --locked
uv run python scripts/build_colab.py
uv run python scripts/build_colab.py --check
uv run python scripts/build_colab_zip.py
uv run --group dev python scripts/check_colab.py --execute
```

The output location is `_build/colab/`. Use `uv run python scripts/build_colab_zip.py` to create `_build/packages/colab-notebooks.zip` without building the Book. The integrated Book build copies validated notebooks and the ZIP to downloads/. It generates 17 notebooks—`setup.ipynb`, `quickstart.ipynb`, and `chapters/01_concepts.ipynb` through `15_multi_agent.ipynb`—along with an instructional README. Distribute the required files individually, or compress this folder and distribute it. You can also share them through Google Drive.

`notebooks/` contains the notebook sources. Helper, data, and example files are maintained at their existing source paths. The generator only reads the sources and writes only to `_build/colab/`. Generated files are excluded from Git and must not be edited directly. Regenerate them whenever sources or dependencies change.

## Providers: Download CI Artifacts

After pushing changes to GitHub, download the artifacts from **Actions → Validate tutorial → successful run → Artifacts → colab-notebooks**. The artifacts contain only the generated notebooks and README. CI is configured to generate the files, check that API execution cells are preserved, and run the notebooks offline before uploading them. The retention period is 30 days.

Downloading GitHub Actions artifacts requires a GitHub login and read access to the repository. For private repositories, an authorized provider downloads them and delivers the files to learners. Learners do not need GitHub access to run the notebooks. [Official GitHub download instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/download-workflow-artifacts)

The automated Jupyter Book publishing workflow remains disabled. The existence of a CI configuration is distinct from successful remote execution and upload. Validation in the actual Colab web interface, on a Linux runtime, and with paid API calls must also be checked separately from offline execution.

The project's source repository is [ksmin23/agents-api-by-example](https://github.com/ksmin23/agents-api-by-example). The standalone notebooks contain no code that downloads from the repository URL, so renaming the repository does not affect them. The ChatGPT Sites download URLs above are maintained separately from GitHub.
